Subject: Action required: redirect orphan opportunities into forecast safety net or archive

Team —

Quick one: I pulled an overnight export (attached) and there are ~18 opportunities in the Q2 commit bucket with either a stale close date (older than 60 days) or no owner activity logged in the last 45 days. Finance flagged these for the upcoming forecast scrub — we can’t continue to carry them as committed without clear next steps.

Please do one of the following by EOD Monday (May 3):
- Confirm a realistic close date and update Stage to Commit (with proof in notes), or
- Move to Commit-Pending (if you're waiting on contract / security approval and add expected date), or
- Mark as Closed-Lost / Archive if there is no reasonable path this quarter.

I’ve attached the CSV with the HubSpot IDs and current fields. If you need me to reassign or help reach out to the buyer, flag the rows and I’ll jump in. We will apply the commit-safety rule if items remain orphaned after the deadline — auto-decommit for forecast purposes.

Link: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/filter/OrphanOpps-20270429
Attachment: forecast_export_20270429.csv

Thanks — quick actions here keep our forecast credible.
Jonas
Director, Sales Operations
Redwood Inference

Folks —

Thanks for the initial moves. Two quick clarifications before I close the loop with Finance:
1) If an opportunity is marked Commit-Pending because of legal/security, please copy the counterparty's point contact in the notes and add an expected date with a short justification. Finance will accept pending items only with that evidence.
2) Anything that remains in Commit without owner activity or an explicit short note will be auto-decommitted for the next forecast refresh. I’m attaching the short rules doc we’ll apply (commit_rules.md) so people are clear on what counts as evidence.

If you need, I can run a 15-minute triage with owners at 2pm today to clear the last 10. Otherwise I’ll move forward with the safety-net decommit at close of business tomorrow for forecasting purposes.

Attachment: commit_rules.md

Jonas
